basics.name: Zohaib Malik
basics.label: Software Engineering Student & Full-Stack / ML Engineer
basics.summary: Third-year Software Engineering student at GIKI with hands-on experience building and shipping full-stack products. Ranked 13th nationally at ICPC Asia Regional 2025. Comfortable across the stack — from REST APIs (FastAPI, Node.js) to React frontends and Machine Learning models.

work.summary: Built and deployed a full-stack P2P textbook exchange platform serving 500+ GIKI students, handling hundreds of weekly transactions. Architected backend REST APIs using FastAPI (Python) and built responsive frontend with React + Vite.
